status: GA since 2026-05-28; gemini-3-pro-image-preview deprecated and shut down 2026-06-25 (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog)
verified: Re-checked 2026-10-19 against ai.google.dev model page, image-generation guide, changelog and pricing. Items marked (unverified) could not be confirmed first-party.
primary_use: Professional asset production with advanced features

aspect_ratios.configuration_format: Exact format like '16:9' in the request (response_format.aspect_ratio in the Interactions API), not in prompt text
aspect_ratios.note_2026_10: Standard Gemini set; 1:1, 5:4 and 16:9 appear in current first-party Pro examples, the full list is not printed for Pro (unverified — confirm on your platform). The 1:4/4:1/1:8/8:1 panoramic ratios are documented for Nano Banana 2.1, not Pro.

resolutions.note: Use uppercase 'K' (e.g., '4K' not '4k') in configuration. No 512px tier on Pro.
resolutions.cost_note: On the Gemini API, 1K and 2K cost the same per image ($0.134); 4K is $0.24 — see pricing.

reference_images.binding: Describe each reference by content and role ("the attached portrait as her identity, the attached fabric as the texture"); ordinals like "Image 1" only as a tiebreaker. Google formula: [Reference images] + [Relationship instruction] + [New scenario].
reference_images.note: Was "5 humans, 6 objects" in skill v1.1; GA docs give 6 object / 5 character / 3 style.

token_limits.note: Replaces the old 32K/1M "context window" figures, which were Gemini-app chat numbers, not this model.

google_search_grounding.availability: Supported on Pro (model page). Also on Nano Banana 2.1; Google Image Search grounding is documented only for 2.1 and 3.1 Flash Image.
google_search_grounding.description: Generate images based on real-time web information
google_search_grounding.configuration: tools=[{"type": "google_search"}] (Interactions API). Older generateContent SDK form: tools=[{"google_search": {}}] (unverified on current docs).

thinking_mode.availability: Always on for all Gemini 3 image models
thinking_mode.behavior: Cannot be disabled in the API. May generate up to two interim "thought" images before the final output.
thinking_mode.levels: Thinking-level table in the image-generation guide does not list Pro — do not send a level (unverified — confirm on your platform)
thinking_mode.billing: Thinking tokens are billed as text/thinking output
thinking_mode.impact: Slower generation but higher quality for complex scenes

text_rendering.syntax: Always use quotation marks for exact text
text_rendering.character_limit: Keep text under 25 characters for best results
best_practices: Use quoted strings for exact rendering

special_features.interleaved_output: Can return text and illustrations mixed in one response; read every part of the response.

api_configuration.endpoint: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions (Interactions API, as in current first-party examples). generateContent with image_config.aspect_ratio / image_config.image_size is the older shape (unverified on current docs).

tools.description: Enable Google Search grounding for real-time data

output_specifications.file_format: Image bytes (base64); PNG vs JPEG depends on request/platform (unverified — confirm on your platform)

rate_limits.paid_tiers: Per-project tier limits — check your AI Studio rate-limit page
rate_limits.note: The old 15 RPM / 1500 RPD free-tier figures no longer apply.

usage_limits_web_app.note: Gemini-app plan figures are from the original research and change often (unverified — confirm on your platform).

limitations.character_consistency: Not 100% reliable across many generations - use multi-turn chat
limitations.small_faces: Struggles with very small faces - use close-up compositions
limitations.text_spelling: Complex spelling can have errors - keep text simple

pricing_gemini_api_usd.priority: $3.60 in / $21.60 text out / $216.00 image out per 1M
pricing_gemini_api_usd.free_tier: None for this model (testable in Google AI Studio)
